page_title: STU 1-1 KOL | Stuttgart v FC Koln 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Patrick Ittrich has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Decent spell from Stuttgart here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in.
90+4' A pass from Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is intercepted by Marvin Schwabe and the move breaks down.
90+3' Substitution. Jan Thielmann will be replaced by Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln).

90+1' Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
90+1' The ball is out of play and Stuttgart manage to earn a corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing.
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart. The linesman makes the right call and Stuttgart will have a corner.
88' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Silas (VfB Stuttgart). Stuttgart get a corner.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Enzo Millot as he is replaced by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).

85' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
84' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:4.
80' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) rises high to meet a cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and powers his header on goal, but the goalkeeper shows his agility and makes a save.
75' FC Koln can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' The attendance for today's match is 54500.
72' The substitution is prepared. Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Florian Kainz.
68' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
67' Substitution. Atakan Karazor makes way for Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart).
65' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Anthony Rouault and he is replaced by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).
65' Here comes a substitution. Woo-Yeong Jeong is given a rest as he is replaced by Silas (VfB Stuttgart).

62' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) scores with a brilliant shot into the left side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Linton Maina. The score is now 1:1.
62' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is about to take a corner kick.
60' Timo Schultz prepares a substitution. Justin Diehl is replaced by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) comes onto the pitch for Denis Huseinbasic.
59' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
56' The Stuttgart players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
53' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Chris Fuhrich laid the ball off to Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart), who unleashed a strong shot from close range into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
49' The resulting set piece from FC Koln is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

49' A lofted cross from Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for FC Koln.
47' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+3' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Marvin Schwabe to dive and make a save. Stuttgart will take a corner kick.
45+2' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

43' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
42' Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
41' The game is interrupted now, Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

40' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
39' Great teamplay by FC Koln as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
35' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
34' Dangerous play by Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln). Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
27' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
25' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Great save! Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Marvin Schwabe.
21' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
20' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

19' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Stuttgart will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
19' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
18' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.

17' Great ball in from Josha Vagnoman. Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.

14' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Marvin Schwabe allowed him to make a comfortable save.
11' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
7' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Stuttgart.
4' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
4' Fabian Bredlow pulls off a great save to deny Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
3' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The first half has started.
Stuttgart will kick the game off.
Patrick Ittrich is introduced as the referee for today's match.
